attribution.note: Win rate by input tertile, pick-side relative. |spread| = high-band win rate minus low-band — bigger magnitude = the metric separates winners from losers harder, and deserves weight. Read direction too: a NEGATIVE spread on a should-be-positive factor is a red flag.

kprops.note: Bias = actual minus projection (positive means we under-project). Leans only counted at 0.7+ strikeout edges. Small samples early — a lean record means little before ~100 graded pitchers.

calibration.note: Shadow ledger for learning only — never part of the public record. Official picks stay the only published record.

recommendations: Full-history record across every analyzed game (all tiers, all dates): 189-144 (56.8%), n=333. This is what the correlations below are measured against -- not just the 22 current-model official picks.
Lab Rating's conviction component score: r=0.120 (n=333) -- a modest relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 2.48): 41-42 (49.4%). Top quarter (20.00 to 35.00): 53-31 (63.1%).
LyDia's own win probability for this pick: r=0.103 (n=333) -- a modest relationship. Bottom quarter (0.44 to 0.54): 40-43 (48.2%). Top quarter (0.70 to 0.74): 53-31 (63.1%).

Team strength blend edge, before any pitcher/bullpen adjustment (picked side minus opponent): r=0.064 (n=188) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-0.18 to -0.06): 26-21 (55.3%). Top quarter (0.08 to 0.23): 29-18 (61.7%).

Size of the price (how big a favorite or underdog this pick was): r=-0.064 (n=327) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (100.00 to 115.00): 43-38 (53.1%). Top quarter (158.00 to 850.00): 51-33 (60.7%).
Lab Rating's offense component score: r=0.062 (n=333) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 12.48): 48-35 (57.8%). Top quarter (25.00 to 50.00): 53-31 (63.1%).

Starting pitcher ERA edge (opponent's ERA minus the picked pitcher's): r=0.044 (n=333) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-2.63 to -0.10): 47-36 (56.6%). Top quarter (1.07 to 4.49): 52-32 (61.9%).
Pick tier (official / value watch / watchlist / pass): official_pick 17-9 (65.4%, n=26) vs. value_watch 3-2 (60.0%, n=5) vs. watchlist 31-21 (59.6%, n=52) vs. pass 138-112 (55.2%, n=250).
Picked the home team vs. the road team: Home 112-71 (61.2%, n=183) vs. Road 77-73 (51.3%, n=150).
These are correlations across LyDia's own analyzed history, not causal proof and not a signal to change any model weight or gate on their own -- human review still required for any actual change.
